questions.question: A school buys 145 tablets at R1 250 each. Work out the total cost.
Cement and sand are mixed in the ratio 1 : 3. How much sand is needed for 15 bags of cement? Explain.
questions.expected_answer: For every 1 bag of cement there are 3 bags of sand, so multiply both parts by 15: 15 bags of cement need 15 × 3 = 45 bags of sand.

questions.question: Explain the difference between a ratio and a rate, with an example of each.
questions.expected_answer: A ratio compares amounts of the same kind, such as 1 cup of concentrate to 4 cups of water. A rate compares amounts of different kinds, joined by per, such as 80 km per hour.
